title: host.massremove
description: Remove related objects from multiple hosts.

hostids.description: IDs of the hosts to be updated. Parameter behavior: required.

groupids.description: IDs of the host groups to remove the given hosts from.

interfaces.description: Host interfaces to remove from the given hosts. The host interface object must have only the ip, dns and port properties defined.

macros.description: User macros to delete from the given hosts. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

templateids.description: IDs of the templates to unlink from the given hosts.

templateids_clear.description: IDs of the templates to unlink and clear from the given hosts.

hostInterfaceRemoveRef.description: Host interface identified by ip, dns and port only, as documented for host.massremove.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface.

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface.

port.description: Port number used by the interface.
